blocks.content: Combine all filters to get the final list of bonus-eligible employees:

1-- Final query for bonus-eligible employees
2
3SELECT *
4FROM Employees
5WHERE department IN ('Sales', 'Finance')
6AND age BETWEEN 23 AND 27;
This query ensures you only retrieve employees who meet all the specified conditions.
